values.name: Inner
values.description: Level of packing, if it exists, that is immediately subordinate to the intermediate packaging level.

values.name: Intermediate
values.description: Level of packaging, if it exists, that is immediately subordinate to the outer packaging level.

values.name: Outer
values.description: For packed merchandise, outermost level of packaging for a shipment.

values.name: No packaging hierarchy
values.description: There is no specifiable level of packaging: packaging is inner and outer level as well.
